capabilities: Render YouTube links in notes as native players with seek, speed, quality, and picture-in-picture controls
Search YouTube and list videos, playlists, and channels from a sidebar panel
Download offline copies of videos into the vault's attachment folder
Play offline video and audio files together without a connection
Replace empty captions with real video titles fetched from YouTube
disambiguation: Not an official YouTube integration; an independent client that may stop working when YouTube changes its service.
extras: Desktop only. Includes extensive disclaimers about legality, YouTube's terms of service, and no liability; the built-in engine may fail on age-restricted, private, live, or very long videos.
intentEvidence: Starnote's YouTube features as an Obsidian plugin.
problem: Obsidian's YouTube embeds load the official iframe, which depends on YouTube's player and offers no search panel or offline copies inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Starnote's YouTube features as an Obsidian plugin.
yt-dlp is strictly optional and user-installed
BRAT then updates it with every release.

summary: YouTube player plugin that renders note links as native in-note players, searches YouTube from a sidebar panel, and saves offline copies using yt-dlp or a built-in engine.
